name: flowtus
description: FLOWTUS v2 — storefront, bookings and admin (Next.js + NestJS + PostgreSQL monorepo)

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @flowtus/core && npm run build -w @flowtus/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @flowtus/api && npm run build -w @flowtus/web && npm run build -w @flowtus/admin
scripts.test: npm run test -w @flowtus/core && npm run test -w @flowtus/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @flowtus/core && npm run typecheck -w @flowtus/api && npm run typecheck -w @flowtus/web && npm run typecheck -w @flowtus/admin
